summary: End-to-end frontend verification of the new Payroll Batch 'One-screen Approve+Pay' and 'HRMS Process Payment + Partial + Retry' flows. All critical UX gates work. One-screen approval dialog correctly pre-selects Partner, enforces Partner/Paid-By/Bank/Remarks mandatory validation (toast on each missing field), submits approval + payment in a single click, and the queue goes empty. HRMS Payroll Batches section lists ZZ Pay Test Center 12/2099 batch; Process Payment opens the batch dialog + auto-opens pay sub-dialog with partner pre-selected; unchecking one employee flips Submit label from 'Record Payment' to 'Pay Selected'; submitting marks the batch as PARTIALLY PAID with the paid staff row showing PAID and remaining showing PENDING; list action switches to 'Retry Payment'; retry dialog pre-selects remaining employee only, already-paid employee is disabled with PAID chip, and partner stays pre-selected; final submit transitions batch to PAID with approval timeline recording pending_payment → partially_paid → paid.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec/test-plan asked for data-testid='batch-status-chip' but DOM only exposes 'batch-detail-status'. Both work and show the chip text ('PARTIALLY PAID' / 'PAID') but the testid name differs from the request.

Spec expected data-testid='batch-row-paystatus-<staff_id>' per row (e.g. batch-row-paystatus-ZZPAYTEST-staff1). These test ids are NOT present in the DOM — the PAID/PENDING badges are rendered without a per-row testid, making automated per-row paystatus assertions impossible.

issues: Year picker shows only [year-3 .. year+1] — to reach the test batch at 12/2099 the automation had to click +1-year 73 times. Not a shipping bug (end-users won't need year 2099), but it blocks easy future-dated test data. Consider a 'jump to year' text input.

action_items: Add data-testid='batch-row-paystatus-<staff_id>' to each staff-wise breakdown row in PayrollBatchDialog so partial-pay regression can assert PAID vs PENDING per row.
(Optional) Also expose data-testid='batch-status-chip' alias on the status chip to match the spec, OR update the spec/doc to use 'batch-detail-status'.
critical_code_review_comments: PayrollPeriodPicker (HRMS.jsx L3225) hard-caps year window at ±1/-3. Fine for prod but inconvenient for future-dated seed data.

Confirmation toasts on pay sub-dialog successful submit are not consistently rendered via [role=status]/.toast selectors — business flow still works (batch transitions correctly), but automated post-success toast assertion is flaky; consider standardizing on the shared toast system used by Approve&Pay ('Approved & payment recorded').
seed_data_creation: No new seed created. Both seeded batches CONSUMED by this test run: ZZPAYTEST-batch-approval → approved + paid in one shot; ZZPAYTEST-batch → partially paid then retried to full PAID. Re-seed via /app/backend/tests/seed_payroll_test.py if re-running.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seeded batches ZZPAYTEST-batch and ZZPAYTEST-batch-approval are now fully paid/approved. If re-testing, re-seed first. ZZ Pay Test Center is at 12/2099 — PayrollPeriodPicker only lets you jump +1 year per open, so automation needs ~73 clicks to reach 2099 (handled in script via loop). All data-testids documented in the review request were found EXCEPT batch-status-chip (use batch-detail-status instead) and batch-row-paystatus-* (not implemented).
rca of the issue: n/a — feature works. The two missing data-testids are documentation/testability gaps in HRMS.jsx PayrollBatchDialog, not functional bugs.
